deploybot: DeployBot: staging deploy initiated by @janet. env=staging commit=6a1b2c3 tag=wave-alpha-rc1 change-window=2026-03-19T22:00Z-23:00Z. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/6789
janet: kicking off smoke runs now. I’ll watch the inference-runtime rollout.
deploybot: rolling out service="inference-runtime" version=wave-alpha-rc1 to 3 shards (shard-0..shard-2). starting canary -> 10% traffic
lee: watching logs and metrics, keeping eyes on 95p latency. oncall pinned to this thread
saurav: seeing a small 95p latency blip on shard-2 at 22:03Z, digging in
janet: can we pause traffic shift if it stays high? i’ll hold manual pin if needed
deploybot: traffic shift paused by @janet per request. current traffic: canary=10% pinned
oncall-bot: ALERT: staging/inference-runtime 95p latency > 450ms (22:04Z) — incident #INC-20260319-01
saurav: root cause looks like temporary kernel OOM on node ig-23 causing tail latency. restarting worker on ig-23 now
lee: restart done, node recycled, cpu and memory back to normal, logs look clean :thumbsup:
deploybot: resuming traffic shift to 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 2m pause steps
janet: smoke checks running (generate/response/timeouts). samples look good so far
saurav: metrics stable for 10m, no error-rate increase, latency back to baseline
lee: quick note — I pinned quantized-model v2 for staging to avoid regressing latency during this wave
janet: added a short release note draft: https://docs.redwood.dev/release-notes/wave-alpha-draft
deploybot: Deploy completed: env=staging commit=6a1b2c3 tag=wave-alpha-rc1 duration=18m artifacts=https://artifacts.redwood.dev/wave-alpha-rc1 If you see issues, rollback: `deploybot rollback --env staging --tag wave-alpha-rc1 --to-tag previous-stable`
janet: thanks all. I’ll promote notes and schedule the change-window for prod tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
lee: thanks — will keep monitoring through the rest of the window
deploybot: closing thread. :package:
